methodologyNotes: Roster covers fourteen rosin presses spanning entry-level 0.75-ton manual/electric personal units to 20-ton industrial hydraulic and pneumatic machines across five manufacturers (NugSmasher, Dabpress, PurePressure, Dulytek, Rosineer), verified 2026-08-12 directly against each manufacturer's own current product pages (nugsmasher.com, dabpress.com, dulytek.com, rosineer.com) and corroborated where useful via authorized retailers (hydrobuilder.com, bghydro.com, greenthumbdepot.com). Two corrections to the seed list: (1) manufacturer's own current "NugSmasher X" product page describes a factory-direct, factory-refurbished, electric one-touch press with 4"x4" plates and no published tonnage figure (only 900 PSI at the material) — distinct from the widely-mirrored retailer copy for "NugSmasher X" (12 tons, 4"x6" plates, ~$989) which on inspection is the spec sheet for the separate NugSmasher XP model; the manufacturer-sourced NugSmasher X spec is used here and NugSmasher XP is listed as its own separate, correctly-specced entry. (2) Several other suggested seed names — Sasquash Q-Series, Ju1ceBox 3-Ton, PurePressure Helix, Grateful Press, a standalone "Lowtemp Plates 20-Ton" press, ATP Rosin Press, Rosin Tech Big Boy, and EZ Press — could not be verified as real, currently-sold products against any manufacturer site or authorized dealer (dead/parked domains, no matching catalog listings, or the underlying company now sells only consumer rosin/vape products rather than press hardware); rather than fabricate specs for these, they were dropped and replaced with verified real presses from the NugSmasher, Dabpress, Dulytek, and Rosineer catalogs to reach the target roster size. pid_temp_control is true only where a source explicitly uses the term "PID" (Dabpress's own copy: "PID Temp Controller Box" / "Precision PID dual control"); every other brand's own copy says only "digital temperature control" without the PID designation, so that field is left null there rather than assumed. priceUsd is left null for PurePressure Longs Peak because no MSRP could be corroborated on a trusted manufacturer or authorized-dealer source (only a single unverified marketplace listing was found). accessedAt 2026-08-12 throughout.

products.name: NugSmasher X Electric Rosin Press
products.priceNote: Factory-refurbished unit sold direct on nugsmasher.com; the manufacturer's current site no longer lists a new-unit price for this model
products.provenance: Manufacturer's own current product page (factory-refurbished listing) describes a one-touch electric press with dual 160W heating elements, 4"x4" smash plates, "NS710" digital temperature control, and 900 PSI of pressure at the material via the NugSmasher X bag — no overall ram tonnage, heat range in °F, weight, or plate material composition is published, so those fields are left null rather than assumed. This is distinct from widely-mirrored third-party retailer copy for "NugSmasher X" (12 tons, 4"x6" plates) which matches the separate NugSmasher XP spec sheet almost exactly; the manufacturer-sourced spec is treated as authoritative for this entry.

products.name: NugSmasher Mini 2-Ton Portable Rosin Press
products.priceNote: Base unit price on nugsmasher.com; accessory bundles at retailers (Trimleaf, Rightbud) run $579-$890
products.provenance: Manufacturer's own product page confirms 2 tons via stowable manual hydraulic pump handle, 2.5"x2.5" 6061 aircraft-grade aluminum plates with 70W heaters per plate, digital heat-plate temperature control (not explicitly branded PID), and 3.5-7 gram press capacity. No heat range in °F or unit weight is published on the manufacturer's page, so both are left null. Corroborated as a real, currently-sold SKU across Trimleaf, Grow Light Central, and Rightbud.

products.name: NugSmasher XP 12-Ton Manual Rosin Press
products.priceNote: Base manufacturer price on nugsmasher.com; bundles with pump/accessory kits run up to $6,198.64
products.provenance: Manufacturer's own product page confirms 12 tons of manually-controlled hydraulic pressure via a manual pump arm, quad 4"x6" 6061 aircraft-grade aluminum smash plates with 160W heaters each, digital temperature control, a pressure gauge reading up to 6000 PSI with companion-app integration, and 28-gram-per-extraction capacity. No heat range in °F or unit weight is published, so both left null. This is the model most third-party retailer copy for "NugSmasher X" actually describes (see nugsmasher-x provenance note).

products.name: NugSmasher Pro 20-Ton Pneumatic Rosin Press
products.priceNote: Base manufacturer price on nugsmasher.com; bundles run up to $12,731.45
products.provenance: Manufacturer's own product page confirms 20 tons of joystick-controlled pneumatic pressure (with a manual pump-handle fallback), 7"x10" heat plates, six 160W heating elements with individually-controlled digital temperature control, a dwell timer via the companion NugSmasher App, up to 84 grams of flower per cycle, and a 90-120 PSI / 3+ gallon compressor requirement. No heat range in °F or unit weight is published, so both left null.

products.name: Dabpress DP-BJ6T35 (Amberiflow) 6-Ton Personal Hydraulic Rosin Press
products.priceNote: Current sale price on dabpress.com (list $499); also sold as "Amberiflow 6-Ton" and cross-listed on eBay/Leafly under SKU dp-bj6t35
products.provenance: Manufacturer's own product page (SKU BJ6T35-US, matching the seed model number DP-BJ6T) confirms a 6-ton (12,000 lb max) hydraulic bottle jack, 3"x5" food-grade anodized aluminum plates, 0-399°F heat range via a "Precision PID" dual-zone synchronized thermal controller with independent thermocouples (±1°F accuracy), 500W dual heating, H-frame steel construction, and 35.4 lb unit weight. No dwell-timer duration is published, so left null. Corroborated as a real current listing on eBay and Leafly under the dp-bj6t35 SKU.

products.name: Dabpress Amberiland 12-Ton Bottle Jack Rosin Press
products.provenance: Manufacturer's own product page confirms a 12-ton (24,000 lb max) industrial bottle jack, 4"x7" dual food-grade anodized aluminum plates, 0-399°F heat range via "Precision PID dual control," dual 600W heaters (1,200W total) on a 4-post heavy-duty steel frame, and 48.5 lb machine weight. No dwell-timer duration is published, so left null.

products.name: Rosinbomb Rocket Electric Rosin Press
products.priceNote: Sale price $637.81 on authorized retailer Hydrobuilder (the cited source page); other retailers list closer to $500-600. Rosinbomb's own site (rosinbomb.com) was showing a "launching soon" placeholder rather than a working store at time of check.
products.provenance: Authorized-retailer product page (Hydrobuilder, reproducing manufacturer spec) confirms up to 1,500 lbs (0.75 tons) of pressing force via a compact electric drive pulling 3A at 110V, 3.2"x2.8" dual heated plates, 35-300°F range, 22-gauge stainless-steel housing, and 13 lb unit weight. Corroborated across 420VapeZone and TVape. Manufacturer's own rosinbomb.com storefront could not be fetched (placeholder "launching soon" page), so exact plate material composition and PID branding could not be confirmed and are left null.

products.name: PurePressure Pikes Peak V2 Pneumatic Rosin Press (Dual Pressure, 10x3in Plates)
products.priceNote: Regular price $9,495.00 on authorized dealer BG Hydro (the cited source page) for the Dual Pressure Control configuration with 10"x3" plates; single-pressure and 10"x2" plate configurations are priced lower

specs.dwell_timer: user-adjustable press time (digital pressure readout, 120 PSI compressed-air cylinder)

products.provenance: Authorized-dealer product page (BG Hydro) plus manufacturer-derived copy mirrored on Elite Metal Tools (SKU PPF005) confirm an oil-less pneumatic cylinder producing nearly 5 tons (9,876 lbf) from 120 PSI compressed air, a choice of 10"x2" or 10"x3" 6061 aluminum heat plates with independent thermocouples accurate to 1°F, 0-300°F range, user control over pressure/time/actuation speed, and a 2-year structural/1-year full-system warranty. No unit weight is published on the fetched sources, so left null. "PID" is not the term the manufacturer uses (independent thermocouples/digital readout instead), so pid_temp_control is left null rather than assumed.

products.name: PurePressure Longs Peak 8-Ton Pneumatic Rosin Press
products.priceNote: Regular price $11,495.00 on authorized dealer Green Thumb Depot (the cited source page); currently listed as sold out

specs.dwell_timer: user-adjustable via Pressware touchscreen software (1 PSI increments)

products.provenance: Authorized-dealer product page (Green Thumb Depot) plus manufacturer-derived copy mirrored on Elite Metal Tools (SKU PPF006) confirm an 8-ton oil-less pneumatic cylinder, 10"x3" 6061 aluminum heat plates, 0-300°F range accurate to 1°F, up to 35g flower / 70g kief-hash capacity per press, a full-color touchscreen running PurePressure's own "Pressware" software for 1-PSI-increment pressure control, and dual orientation legs for vertical or horizontal use. No unit weight is published on the fetched sources, so left null; pid_temp_control left null as the manufacturer's own term is "Pressware"-controlled pressure/temperature, not "PID."

products.name: Dulytek DM800 Portable Manual Heat Press
products.provenance: Manufacturer's own product page confirms up to 1,500 lbs (0.75 tons) of force via a hand-lever mechanism with locking lever and adjustable pressure knob, 2.5"x3" dual insulated solid-aluminum heating plates, room-temp to 302°F range, a 0-999 second digital timer, 120W 110V/220V heating, and a 9.8 lb unit weight. Temperature control is described only as dual-channel, not PID-branded, so left null.

products.name: Dulytek DHP5 5-Ton Hydraulic Heat Press
products.priceNote: Sale price on dulytek.com (list $459); accessory bundle version runs $489/$519

specs.dwell_timer: integrated timer (exact duration range not published)

products.provenance: Manufacturer's own product page confirms 5 tons (10,000 lb max) via a replaceable hydraulic bottle jack with overpressure protection, 3"x4" dual insulated solid-aluminum plates, up to 302°F, a two-channel digital temperature-and-timer controller, and a 31 lb unit weight. Temperature control is described only as a precision two-channel controller, not PID-branded, so left null.

products.name: Dulytek DHP20 20-Ton Hydraulic Heat Press

specs.dwell_timer: digital timer (exact duration range not published)

products.provenance: Manufacturer's own product page confirms 20 tons (40,000 lb max) via a removable manual hydraulic bottle jack, 8"x3" insulated solid-aluminum plates, up to 302°F, an "upgraded precise two-channel temperature controller" with settable press-time, and a 100 lb unit weight. Temperature control is described only as two-channel precision, not PID-branded, so left null.

products.name: Rosineer MIGHTY-5 5-Ton Hydraulic Heat Press
products.provenance: Manufacturer's own product page confirms 5 tons via a built-in hydraulic bottle jack, 3"x4" solid insulated aluminum plates, up to 302°F, a two-channel digital control panel for temperature and time (up to 300 sec), a built-in pressure gauge, optional tilting collection function, and 34.7 lb net / 48.4 lb gross weight. Temperature control is digital but not PID-branded, so left null.

products.name: Rosineer AUTO 4-Ton Hybrid Heat Press
products.provenance: Manufacturer's own product page confirms up to 4 tons via a hybrid electric-hydraulic press/release button system (800-1800W), 3"x5" separately-heated solid insulated aluminum plates, up to 356°F, a two-channel digital control panel, roughly 9-15 gram capacity, and 52.9 lb unit weight. No dwell-timer duration is published, so left null.
